text: The earlier bulk cleanup removed the XPCOM MessengerProfileMigrator entry, but --migration still depends on that service. The restoration registers its CID, @mozilla.org/toolkit/profile-migrator;1 contract and ES module together. The Marionette test checks about:import#start in a secondary content tab. Review component registrations and command-line entry points independently of deleted UI files. The current caller remains; no build or Marionette execution was done.
title: Keep the profile migrator registration when removing old migration UI
